notes.title: Weeklong Deal chance
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40958567/16e3feaa30c512242d3dce35a797ff4abba556c7.png[/img]

Ankora Lost Days is an exploration adventure where you can discover every corner of the planet of Ankora in Polly Pocket style scenarios. 

If you haven't yet experienced this adventure from [url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/28033/Chibig_Universe_Games/]Chibig's gaming universe[/url], this is your chance to get it with a [b]60% discount during the Weeklong Deal[/b] - from February 22nd to 28th!

[previewyoutube=9c1IL4mNwXM;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]










[b]About Ankora Lost Days[/b]

Mûn is a Junior Ranger from the Interstellar Patrol, stranded on the unexplored planet Ankora after her spaceship crashes there. Mûn will need to craft her own tools to collect the necessary resources for her adventure, overcoming many obstacles: rivers, lakes, waterfalls, mountains... and monsters.

Discover the wild planet of Ankora in a single-player survival adventure with exploration and crafting. A tale about growing up, making friends and connecting with nature.

[list]
[*] Build, modify the terrain and the bow to defend yourself!
[*] Explore a wide variety of biomes, from deserts to meadows to snowy mountains.
[*] Level up with each action. Learn new recipes and skills in order to improve your chances of surviving.
[*] Visuals inspired by Studio Ghibli films like Nausicaä of the Valley of the Wind.
[*] Meet spacefaring explore Mûn as a rookie, long before the events of Deiland: Pocket Planet and Summer in Mara.
[/list]

Have you already experienced this adventure and want to explore the rest of Chibig's stories? Get the [b]Chibig Universe bundle[/b] at a reduced price and discover the rest of the adventures and connected characters.

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/28033/Chibig_Universe_Games/

Take advantage of these offers and continue discovering wonderful places, charming characters and opening your heart to adventures you will never forget.

notes.title: Ankora: Lost Days - V1.05 improvements and fixes
notes.content:
Hi there friends,

Thanks for playing Ankora, we have enjoyed your gameplays and support via steam forums, social shares, and reviews.

We have been working hard during the past few days and we have updated the game with a daily patch.
That's the things we have improved until now (v1.05):

- Added character names to the map.
- Show information about the stats in the Level up UI.
- Added navigation information to the menus.
- Fixed the Show Map button label in the Quest Detail UI.
- Some little fixes in the tutorial.
- Solved the bug with the North Portal.
- Remove some language placeholder text (please select one of the languages available from the main menu).
- Added volume slider for the music in the options menu.
- Added some extra prompts at the beginning to help with player guidance.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40958567/d2e20208455c19fd27cea3357f57c28c06cdba18.png[/img]

We are really committed to improving your experience with Ankora: Lost Days. Please, let us know your thoughts, bug reporting, and suggestion in the forum channels. 

Best regards,
Chibig team

notes.title: Time to camp in the woods! Ankora: Lost Days arrives today on Steam!
notes.content:
Hi there friends,

Today is a very special day for us, because Ankora: Lost Days arrives today on Steam! We can’t wait to see how much you explore on this uncharted planet and what your journey holds along with Mûn. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40958567/d2e20208455c19fd27cea3357f57c28c06cdba18.png[/img]

In case any bug appears to block your way through Ankora, you can join our Discord server, post on Steam forums or drop us an email (support@chibig.com) to leave us feedback and report any issues, also you can just join to meet our growing community. We’ll check all your messages and we will try to do our best with the most crucial issues, but we are a small team, so please, bear with us! 

[url=https://discord.gg/qekPvKxc]https://discord.gg/qekPvKxc[/url]

Also, remember that a physical edition of Ankora: Lost Days is on the way thanks to our partners of Tesura Games. Keep an eye on it, because a suuupeer cute and many perks will be included in this edition that releases later this year.

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40958567/a9d81af189e4e485e6327b361be43375b69abb47.jpg[/img]

If you start playing today and you would like to share screenshots or stream the game, please tag us on social media! Also, if you are enjoying the adventures of Mûn in Ankora, please leave us a review! It’s a tremendous help for the game and allow us to reach more people that might enjoy the game. 

 It has been an amazing journey and we wouldn't have made it without your support! See you in Ankora!

Thank you very much!

We have a very special announcement for today. If you’re a player and a fan of Ankora: Lost Days, you might want to check this: Chibig Presents is a new showcase from our studio on the 2nd February 2022 where we will share with you all the news regarding Ankora and other Chibig Universe titles. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40958567/d2e20208455c19fd27cea3357f57c28c06cdba18.png[/img]

We’re going to talk not only about Ankora, but also about Deiland: Pocket Planet, Summer in Mara, Stories of Mara, and brand new game reveals. We’ve been working really hard this year to bring to you new and exciting games. And not only farm games!

Join us on February 2nd to know more about the new projects and games from us. The event will be streamed in our Steam pages so you can follow the event and catch up with all the new announcements.

We wouldn’t make it without your support! Thank you very much!

See you in Ankora!

notes.content:
The day finally has arrived![url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/chibig/ankora-lost-days-a-cute-as-heck-exploration-adventure?ref=7uudfh] Ankora: Lost Days campaign is now live[/url]!

I'm gonna need your help to tell my story and get my game release thanks to Kickstarter!

Mûn here  (•◡•) / speaking to all the Interstellar Explorers! If you receive this message, please, check my new Kickstarter campaign about that incident in Ankora.

You know what I'm talking about!

Take a look here (っ＾▿＾）
https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/chibig/ankora-lost-days-a-cute-as-heck-exploration-adventure?ref=7uudfh

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40958567/0af32932e81884cb454e26ff1e0214bde2e46701.png[/img]

Mûn is a Junior Ranger from the Interstellar Patrol, stranded in Ankora, an unknown planet after her spaceship crashes there. Ankora: Lost Days happens before the events in Deiland: Pocket Planet and Summer in Mara. 

Ankora: Lost Days mixes terraforming, crafting, and exploring mechanics in a wild planet with a colorful style. Mûn must learn to overcome obstacles: rivers, lakes and waterfalls, mountains, level jumps... And many monsters. She will soon learn to make her own paths because Ankora is a unique and changing planet.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40958567/a9d81af189e4e485e6327b361be43375b69abb47.jpg[/img]

See you in Ankora!

notes.title: Welcome to your tiny planet!
notes.content:
Welcome to your tiny planet!

The Steam Page for Deiland: Pocket Planet is now live! Deiland: Pocket Planet is a relaxing farming adventure where you will have to take care of your tiny planet set in the same universe as Ankora. 

Farm, craft, and explore in this new version of the original Deiland with unique content. Whether you want to relax, explore or harvest your own crops, your planet is awaiting for you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40958567/475e1ab28970bf5ab7c29afd655fcd1a1b563f4d.png[/img]

This reimagination of Deiland, released previously on Nintendo Switch, including new looks, new music, new playability, and exclusive DLC content released on the previous game. On top of all of this, this new edition includes a new “seasons'' system. 

If you have Deiland, the previous version of the original game, on your Steam Library, don’t worry. You won’t have to purchase it again. Just complete this [url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSfKH6b-Ga1YneVrcRija8zCe6XRlkWOP6yLVsl8tszqMB0Vrg/viewform?usp=sf_link]form[/url] before the game releases and we’ll send a Steam key for Deiland: Pocket Planet for free! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40958567/ebe09b2f97c46d3a5598afb9d450ff1d05e79208.png[/img]

Whether you want to get notified when the game is released or you are waiting to receive your key for having the original Deiland, please add the game to your wishlist! It is a huge help for us. Thank you! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1623700/Deiland_Pocket_Planet/

Ease up the bustling, everyday routine taking care of your tiny planet 🥰
